purpose: Teach: 変質/崇高/安堵/慰謝/感知/講ずる/発病/成就

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の人格が変質した経緯を警察、確認されてますね
lines.en: In this case, the police have confirmed the circumstances of how the suspect's personality changed, haven't they?
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful cadence. Soft opening. Acknowledging observation with gentle respect. The tone of someone noticing something quietly significant without fanfare.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、崇高な使命感で日々務めております
lines.en: The police work every day with that noble sense of purpose.
lines.style: Formal but not distant. Steady, clear delivery. A statement of principle spoken with quiet certainty. No defensiveness — simply affirming what the work demands.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者ご家族が安堵された瞬間を警察、見届けられましたね
lines.en: In this case, the police were there to witness the moment when the victim's family felt relief, weren't they?
lines.style: Contemplative, almost wondering. Gentle emphasis on 'witness'—not as observer but as someone who truly saw. Slower pace. The respect of recognizing something quietly profound.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者への慰謝制度のご案内も行います
lines.en: The police also provide guidance on compensation systems available to victims.
lines.style: Measured, informative tone. Speaking from established procedure with steady assurance. Not rushed — each part of the system explained with care for those who need to hear it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、被害を早期に感知されましたね
lines.en: In this case, the police detected the harm early on, didn't they?
lines.style: Appreciative, almost admiring. Quiet acknowledgment of something done well. Slight lift on the recognition. Not flattery—genuine noting of capability.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、対策を講ずる前に予兆を捉えます
lines.en: The police catch the signs before measures need to be taken.
lines.style: Calm statement of fact. Even pace. The confidence of someone describing something practiced and proven. Professional assurance without arrogance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、集団発病的な事案にも対応されてますね
lines.en: In this case, the police respond even to cases like mass illness incidents, don't they?
lines.style: Wondering, appreciative. Soft opening. Recognition of scope without excess. The tone of noticing how broad the responsibility truly is.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市民の願いを成就させる活動を続けます
lines.en: The police continue working to fulfill the wishes of the people.
lines.style: Solemn, grounded resolution. Spoken with quiet conviction—not grand, but earnest. The closing of a conversation that has affirmed something important. Slight breath before the final phrase.
